Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Preserve scope and constraints. Do not invent context, requirements, or missing information. Do not perform the task.", "input": "can you draft a correction for the Cedar Vale Ledger's Monday, June 17 issue? the short item was called “Riverside garden opens to neighbors.” It said the garden opened on June 8 and has 16 plots, but those details are wrong: the opening was June 9, and there are 18 plots. I need a brief correction that states both corrected facts clearly and identifies the item and issue so readers can find it. Keep it neutral and straightforward, like a local newspaper correction, not a new version of the whole article. Please address the draft to Soraya, not Orson. I’m asking for the correction text, not for you to contact the paper or look up anything else. Use only the information here; if a detail such as a reporter’s name isn’t provided, leave it out. Make it easy to paste into an email, but don’t add a subject line or sign-off unless one is necessary to make the correction readable.", "output": "Draft a brief, neutral correction for the Cedar Vale Ledger’s Monday, June 17 issue. The correction is for the item “Riverside garden opens to neighbors.” It should clearly state that the garden opened on June 9, not June 8, and has 18 plots, not 16. Identify the item and issue so readers can find it, and do not rewrite the full article. Address the draft to Soraya, not Orson. Use only the information provided; leave out details such as a reporter’s name if they are not given. Make the correction easy to paste into an email, without adding a subject line or sign-off unless needed for readability. Do not contact the paper or look up additional information."}]
